scenes.narration: Who are you? That's authentication. What are you allowed to do? That's authorization. And what did you do? That's accounting.

scenes.heading: The nightclub security team
scenes.narration: Three guards share the job. The first guard checks your I D. The second guard decides which rooms you can enter. The third guard writes down where you went. On Cisco, turn it all on with aaa new model.

scenes.heading: The protocols
scenes.narration: A A A is a framework, and two protocols deliver it. R A D I U S uses U D P, and T A C A C S plus uses T C P. R A D I U S encrypts only the password, but T A C A C S plus encrypts everything. T A C A C S plus keeps all three separate.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Authentication, authorization, accounting. R A D I U S uses U D P, and T A C A C S plus uses T C P. A A A is a framework, not a protocol. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva AAA lab.
